map.plist 有三种格式：XML、二进制（binary1）与旧式 ASCII。文本: plist has three formats: XML, binary (binary1) and the legacy ASCII form. Text editors can only open the XML format directly; binary files must be converted first. In rare cases a plist uses a non-UTF-8 encoding or contains a corrupt length field, which makes parsing fail — in that case re-export it from the source.

map.用 XML 解析器把 plist 文本解析为文档对象，出现解析错误节点时抛出 X: An XML parser parses the plist text into a document object, throwing an XML parse error when a parse-error node appears. The first child element of the plist root is taken as the value's root node and recursively converted to JSON by node type (dict to object, array to array, string, integer, and boolean to their corresponding types). real, date, data, and integers beyond ±(2^53−1) are kept in JSON as objects tagged with __plistType preserving their original text, and restored to native tags on write-back, so real 1.0 is not downgraded to integer, date/data not to string, and large integers keep full precision. Before write-back, XML-illegal control characters in U+0000–U+001F except tab/LF/CR are stripped and the count is reported. Finally JSON is output indented with two spaces
